description: This source code file defines the TransactionRecoveryTestsRunner class, which is responsible for executing and validating transaction recovery tests in an Orleans-based distributed system. It contains methods to simulate silo failures, coordinate transactions, and verify system consistency post-recovery.

classes.name: TransactionRecoveryTestsRunner
classes.description: A test runner class designed for conducting transaction recovery tests in an Orleans cluster, including failure simulation and result validation.

classes.name: ExpectedGrainActivity
classes.description: A helper class representing expected and actual activity states of a transactional grain during tests, including methods to retrieve current state.

methods.name: Log
methods.description: Outputs a log message with timestamp.

methods.name: TransactionWillRecoverAfterRandomSiloGracefulShutdown
methods.description: Tests recovery after a silo is gracefully shut down.

methods.name: TransactionWillRecoverAfterRandomSiloUnGracefulShutdown
methods.description: Tests recovery after a silo is ungracefully killed.

methods.name: TransactionWillRecoverAfterRandomSiloFailure
methods.description: Performs the core logic of testing recovery after a silo failure, either graceful or ungraceful.

methods.name: WakeupGrains
methods.description: Activates a list of grains by pinging them.

methods.name: RunWhileSucceeding
methods.description: Runs transactions while they succeed or until an end condition is met.

methods.name: CheckTxResult
methods.description: Checks the transaction results post-failure and recovery, asserting success if required.

methods.name: RunAllTxReportFailed
methods.description: Runs all transactions and reports those that failed.

methods.name: AllTxSucceed
methods.description: Determines whether all transactions in given groups succeeded.

methods.name: SetBit
methods.description: Sets a bit in grains and updates expected states, handling exceptions.

methods.name: ValidateResults
methods.description: Validates the actual states of grains against expected states after transactions.
